title: Animated Web Journal Development -- 2
description: Hi — this is a strong fit for D’AUBE SONNTAG’s interactive web and motion work. I’d build v1 as a lightweight vintage journal with editable pages, browser-local persistence, realistic page flips, subtle petal and stardust effects, page/tab navigation, responsive behavior, and the requested 30–45 second promo capture. I’d keep the first delivery deliberately bounded: local browser saving is included; cross-device account sync is excluded unless you want it added as a separate milestone. D’AUBE-owned systems use React/TypeScript/Three.js and production visual/performance QA, so I’d tune animation density for smooth mobile behavior rather than only desktop. Delivery is 2 days including source, assets, README and promo video. Before build I’d confirm only the target page count and whether you want local-only persistence or a later cross-device sync milestone.

excluded_unless_change_order: additional themes beyond the agreed vintage direction

evidence_policy: Use only D’AUBE-owned product/system work as capability evidence; do not represent it as past client work.
